description: Implement device session management with a settings page showing active sessions (device, browser, location, last active time) and ability to sign out individual sessions or all other devices. Integrates with FEAT-003 login_activities for display data.
steps: Create sessions migration adding columns to sessions table: user_id (unsignedBigInteger, nullable, index), ip_address (string, 45), user_agent (text), last_activity (integer, index) - these are Laravel's default session columns if not already present

Create app/Http/Controllers/Settings/SecurityController.php with methods: index() to show active sessions page, destroySession(sessionId) to logout specific session, destroyOtherSessions() to logout all except current
In SecurityController->index(), query sessions table for current user's sessions joined with last login_activity for each session to get device/browser/location display data

Create resources/views/settings/security.blade.php following Mwalimu design with list of active sessions showing: device icon, browser name + version, platform, location (city, country), IP address (masked: xxx.xxx.xxx.XXX), last active timestamp, and 'Sign Out' button per session
Add 'Sign Out All Other Devices' button at top of page that calls destroyOtherSessions() and shows password confirmation modal first (user must re-enter password to confirm)
Implement destroySession() by deleting specific session record from sessions table
Implement destroyOtherSessions() using Auth::logoutOtherDevices($password) after password verification
Add routes to routes/web.php: GET /settings/security, DELETE /settings/security/sessions/{sessionId}, POST /settings/security/sessions/destroy-others
Add 'Security' navigation link in user dashboard sidebar/menu pointing to route('settings.security')
Test: log in from multiple browsers/devices, verify all sessions appear on security page, sign out one session and verify it's removed, sign out all others and verify only current session remains
acceptance_criteria: Security settings page displays all active sessions for current user
Each session shows device, browser, platform, location, IP (masked), and last active time
User can sign out individual sessions via 'Sign Out' button
User can sign out all other devices after password confirmation
Signed out sessions are immediately invalidated and removed from list
Current session is never logged out when using 'Sign Out All Other Devices'
Page design matches existing Mwalimu brand style
verification: Log in to http://localhost:8000/dashboard with valid credentials
Verify current session appears in active sessions list with correct device/browser/location details
Open incognito/private browser window and log in with same account
Refresh security page in first browser - verify both sessions now listed
Click 'Sign Out' button on second session - verify it's removed from list
Verify incognito window is now logged out (refresh shows login page)
Log in from incognito again, then click 'Sign Out All Other Devices' in first browser
Enter password in confirmation modal and submit
Verify only current session remains in list, incognito session is logged out
